eps.d: William Guile organizes a team of martial artists to take on a criminal who's stolen a dangerous biological virus.

eps.t: The Strongest Woman in the World
eps.d: Bison takes over a nuclear facility in China; Guile assigns Blanka and Chun-Li to stop Bison, but Chun-Li has revenge on her mind.
Guile is captured when he and Dee Jay are ambushed by Bison; Bison tries to brainwash Guile so he'll destroy the team.
Blanka, Chun-Li and Guile set out to rescue a young boy that gets trapped in a building.
Bison steals a top secret military plane that can turn invisible at the push of a button.
A military laser gets stolen by Satin Hammer and T. Hawk; T. Hawk gets confronted.
Bison demands a huge sum of money and uses his powers to redirect a comet toward Earth.
Escher sends the Street Fighters to India to compete in a Street Fighter tournament.
After concocting a serum, a scientist is captured and held for ransom by Vega.
Sachi goes missing in Hong Kong while the Street Fighters are investigating a local drug operation.
A small city is in chaos after rare diamonds are found to be rich in the region.
Delta Red captures Bison; Zangief places bombs in a tunnel that connects a train track between England and France.
A mysterious warrior starts destroying strongholds; Akuma wants Bison and Guile to fight each other.
Dhalsim asks the Street Fighters to stop the Satin Hammer from stealing an atomic bomb.
A crime wave takes over London; during a fight, Bison seemingly takes over Cammy's mind.
Mysterious mutant assailants attack Chun-Li and kidnap her TV crew.
Akuma challenges Ryu and Ken; Ken injures Ryu's left arm while training.

eps.t: So, You Want to Be in Pictures
eps.d: Ryu and Ken are asked to help Fei Long with a movie project; Ken writes himself in as the star.
Vega escapes and flies to Hawaii for a final battle; Mei Lei is taken hostage.
Bison charges Cammy and La Lupa to steal a priceless Kali statue for him.
Rose senses many powers fluctuating out of control; Rose kidnaps Ken and Blanka.
Bison threatens the world with an orb that has the power to control all weather.
While searching for a mysterious healing plant, Blanka encounters a wild jungle boy who swears revenge against the natives for killing his family.
Sagat burns down buildings that have posters of Ryu; Sakura convinces Ryu to fight Sagat.
A ruthless street gang known as Mad Gear kidnaps Mayor Mike Haggar's daughter.
Bison captures Delta Red; Bison compiles doomsday codes; Sagat gives Guile and Chun-Li a package that contains the secret of Cammy's past.
